'''Ghorman''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Sern sector/Legends|Sern sector]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region. It was the site of the infamous [[Ghorman Massacre/Legends|Ghorman Massacre]]. [[Fang Zar/Legends|Fang Zar]] had a residence on the planet.

It lay on the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
A temperate [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Ghorman was the site of the [[Ghorman Massacre/Legends|Ghorman Massacre]], an early atrocity committed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] shortly after its formation. In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], an anti-tax demonstration by the Ghorman citizens ended in tragedy when [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] purposefully landed his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] on top of the crowd of peaceful demonstrators, killing and injuring hundreds.<ref name="RASB2" />

The members of the former [[Delegation of 2000]] were spurred by the Ghorman Massacre to begin plotting open rebellion against the Empire, plans which would culminate in the formal creation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] some seventeen years later. As a result of his action, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] promoted Tarkin to the rank of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]].

In the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], the planet was represented by [[Gebnerret Vibrion]].<ref name="DNH" />

An Imperial base was later established on Ghorman. During the early [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an Imperial [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] convoy consisting of 3 [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] called ''[[Century 1]]'', ''[[Century 2]]'', and ''[[Century 3]]'' was en route to the new base and had already rendezvoused with a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] escort when the Rebels deployed a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] along with an [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearhead]] from [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] to [[Raid above Ghorman|attack]] the convoy. The R-22 held off the attacking TIEs while the Y-wing destroyed the convoy. The loss of necessary supplies managed to delay the completion of the outpost for an entire year. The Rebels later recreated the mission as a simulation for training new [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].<ref name="Xwing" />

Later during the Galactic Civil War, Ghorman was the site of a [[Battle of Ghorman|battle]] between the Empire and the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="TNEGtWaT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Ghorman in the Sesswenna (sic) sector of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] is actually located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and Ghorman's location was established to be the [[Sern sector/Legends|Sern sector]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region by other media.<ref name="SWTJ" /><ref name="EAOC" />
